source: Converted from art_11_par_1/raw/suite/art11_scenarios.pl (19 plunit tests written by Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11) plus 7 added scenarios. Expected answers are not legally validated; scenarios marked interpretive rest on a reading, see art_11_par_1/raw/README.md. Recipients changed from category atoms to entities (nca1, nb1) on 2026-11-13.

sentences.S1: The technical documentation of a high-risk AI system shall be drawn up before that system is placed on the market or put into service and shall be kept up-to date.
sentences.S2: The technical documentation shall be drawn up in such a way as to demonstrate that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements set out in this Section and to provide national competent authorities and notified bodies with the necessary information in a clear and comprehensive form to assess the compliance of the AI system with those requirements.
sentences.S3: It shall contain, at a minimum, the elements set out in Annex IV.
sentences.S4: SMEs, including start-ups, may provide the elements of the technical documentation specified in Annex IV in a simplified manner.
sentences.S5: To that end, the Commission shall establish a simplified technical documentation form targeted at the needs of small and microenterprises.
sentences.S6: Where an SME, including a start-up, opts to provide the information required in Annex IV in a simplified manner, it shall use the form referred to in this paragraph.
sentences.S7: Notified bodies shall accept the form for the purposes of the conformity assessment.

draw_up_before_entry.desc: documentation drawn up before the earlier of placing on the market and putting into service; late is a breach, the duty exists before launch

keep_up_to_date.desc: documentation updated after each change to the system

duty_bearer.desc: the provider duties bind the provider of that system only

demonstrate_compliance.desc: documentation demonstrates compliance with Chapter III Section 2; open-textured, decided by an assessor's finding

provide_information.desc: clear and comprehensive information for national competent authorities and notified bodies; open-textured

annex_iv_minimum.desc: documentation contains at least the Annex IV elements, also for SMEs

sme_simplified_permission.desc: SMEs (start-ups only if they are SMEs) may provide the Annex IV elements in a simplified manner

commission_form.desc: the Commission must establish the simplified form; unconditional

sme_must_use_form.desc: an SME that opts for the simplified manner for a system must use the Commission form for it

notified_body_accepts_form.desc: the notified body assessing a system must accept documentation submitted on the form

inputs.meaning: high_risk_ai_system(S): S is a high-risk AI system
provider(P, S): P is the provider of system S
sme(P): P is an SME (small or medium-sized enterprise)
start_up(P): P is a start-up (does not by itself make P an SME)
happens(Event, Time): Event occurred at integer Time. Events: placed_on_market(S), put_into_service(S), documentation_drawn_up(S), system_changed(S), documentation_updated(S)
technical_documentation(S, Doc): Doc is the technical documentation of system S
contains(Doc, annex_iv_elements): Doc contains the Annex IV elements
finding(Doc, Criterion, Assessor, met|not_met): an assessor's finding on an open-textured criterion (clear_and_comprehensive, demonstrates_compliance)
opts_for_simplified(P, S): P opted to provide the Annex IV information for S in the simplified manner
submitted_using(Doc, Form): Doc was submitted using Form (the Commission form is the constant commission_simplified_form)
notified_body(NB): NB is a notified body
national_competent_authority(A): A is a national competent authority
assesses(NB, S): NB conducts the conformity assessment of S
rejected_for_form(NB, Doc): NB rejected Doc because of the form it was submitted on

queries.meaning: obligation(Bearer, Action, Deadline): Bearer is under a duty to perform Action. Deadline is free text and is never queried with a constant; bind it to anything
permission(Bearer, Action): Bearer is permitted to perform Action
violation(Bearer, Action): Bearer has breached the duty to perform Action, derived from the facts
status(Bearer, Action, breached|met|undetermined): three-valued state of a duty; undetermined when an open-textured criterion has no finding

actions: draw_up(S): draw up the technical documentation of S
keep_up_to_date(S): keep the technical documentation of S up to date
demonstrate_compliance(S): documentation of S demonstrates compliance with the Section's requirements
provide_information(S, Recipient): documentation of S provides the necessary information to Recipient, an entity that is a national competent authority or a notified body
include_annex_iv(S): documentation of S contains the Annex IV elements
simplify_annex_iv(S): provide the Annex IV elements for S in a simplified manner (a permission)
use_form(S, Form): use Form for the simplified documentation of S
establish(Form): establish the simplified documentation form
accept(Doc, Form): accept Doc submitted on Form for the conformity assessment

scenarios.reason: The duty arises from high-risk status, not from launch; nothing is late yet
Late documentation is a breach; the duty must not disappear
Documented before the deadline
'Placed on the market or put into service': the deadline is the earlier event
Duties bind the provider of that system (Article 16, not in the paragraph)
'May' is a permission; the form duty applies only after opting in
Simplification changes the presentation, not the Annex IV content
Once opted in, the Commission form is mandatory
The choice is made per system's documentation
The permission is limited to SMEs
'SMEs, including start-ups': start-ups are a subset of SMEs
The minimum content is missing once the system is on the market
A change after the last update makes the documentation outdated
Updated after the change
'Clear and comprehensive' is open-textured; the program must not decide it
An assessor found the information not clear and comprehensive
The Commission's duty does not depend on any fact about enterprises
The duty arises for the body conducting the assessment, for documentation submitted on the form
Rejecting the form breaches the acceptance duty
S5, S6 and S7 speak of one form: the term the Commission must establish is the term the SME must use
Same form identity, between S5 and S7
S2 names two recipients; both are owed the information
An assessor found that the documentation does not demonstrate compliance
Open-textured: no finding, no verdict
Nothing changed, so nothing is outdated
Only an SME can opt for the simplified manner, so only an SME can be bound to the form
